headline: Indian Markets Enter Samvat 2083 with Muhurat Trading as Nifty 50 Holds Above 25,000

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Indian stocks recorded their best weekly performance in six years, outperforming global tech markets
The market enters Samvat 2083 with strong momentum, keeping the Nifty 50 above the 25,000 mark
Positive domestic sentiment and strong global cues led to a significant rally in the preceding days
Historical data indicates a positive trend for markets during the special Muhurat Trading sessions
whatHappening: NSE is hosting the annual Muhurat Trading session to mark the occasion of Diwali Laxmi Pujan
The Sensex recently crossed the 81,000 milestone despite volatility in US and Asian markets
Investors are monitoring key support and resistance levels as the new Hindu calendar year begins
Market participants are analyzing 20 years of data showing historical gains during Muhurat sessions
summary: Indian markets celebrate Diwali with a special Muhurat Trading session today, marking the start of Samvat 2083. The Nifty 50 enters the new year above 25,000 following its strongest weekly performance in six years. Despite global volatility, domestic sentiment remains bullish with the Sensex recently crossing the 81,000 mark.
